subject: English Language
source_note: TIE (2023), English Language Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education Form I-IV

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of English language skills

sub_topics.title: Develop listening skills
competences: (a) Participate in various conversations in different communicative settings (e.g., peer discussions, storytelling)
(b) Summarise information from oral presentations and audio/audio-visual sources
(c) Paraphrase information presented orally

objectives.text: (a) Participate in various conversations in different communicative settings (e.g., peer discussions, storytelling)
objectives.teaching_methods: Discussion, Storytelling, Dialogue, Interview, Round table circle
objectives.resources: Texts of a wide range of events, pictures and recorded materials on various situations, songs, language games
objectives.assessment_criteria: Participations in conversations in various communicative settings is done effectively

objectives.text: (b) Summarise information from oral presentations and audio/audio-visual sources
objectives.assessment_criteria: Information from oral presentations and audio/audio-visual sources is summarised logically

objectives.text: (c) Paraphrase information presented orally
objectives.assessment_criteria: Information presented orally is paraphrased correctly

sub_topics.title: Produce short and coherent oral messages with intelligible pronunciation and fluency
competences: (a) Construct sentences with proper intonation
(b) Use cohesive devices to deliver oral presentations of events (e.g., first of all, moreover, but, however, yet, in contrast, although, otherwise, still, on the contrary, on the other hand)

objectives.text: (a) Construct sentences with proper intonation
objectives.resources: Dictionaries, speakers, written texts, recorded materials on various situations
objectives.assessment_criteria: Sentences with proper intonation are constructed appropriately

objectives.text: (b) Use cohesive devices to deliver oral presentations of events (e.g., first of all, moreover, but, however, yet, in contrast, although, otherwise, still, on the contrary, on the other hand)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Cohesive devices are used to deliver oral presentations logically

sub_topics.title: Develop vocabulary from conversations and written texts
competences: (a) Recognise words with opposite meanings from conversations and written texts
(b) Use words from conversations and written texts to produce new vocabulary by attaching suffixes and prefixes (e.g., kind-unkind; slow-slowly)

objectives.text: (a) Recognise words with opposite meanings from conversations and written texts
objectives.teaching_methods: Roleplay, TIPS, Hot seat, Brainstorming, Discussion, Memory card game
objectives.resources: Audio and audio-visual materials (audio/video clips, recorded stories), texts of different types, dictionaries, encyclopaedia, thesaurus
objectives.assessment_criteria: Words with opposite meanings from conversations and written texts are recognised

objectives.text: (b) Use words from conversations and written texts to produce new vocabulary by attaching suffixes and prefixes (e.g., kind-unkind; slow-slowly)
objectives.teaching_methods: Talk show, Prefix and suffix bingo
objectives.assessment_criteria: New vocabulary is correctly formed from conversations and written texts by attaching suffixes and prefixes

sub_topics.title: Use appropriate grammar and vocabulary in oral and in written language tasks
competences: (a) Produce contextualised oral and written descriptions based on personal experience

(b) Compose passages on specific contexts (structure: tenses –past progressive, present perfect, past perfect, present progressive, adjectives, adverbs, coordinators, prepositions, determiners, conjunctions)
(c) Present messages in formal discussions on various issues using correct grammar and vocabulary

objectives.text: (a) Produce contextualised oral and written descriptions based on personal experience
objectives.resources: Audio and audio-visual materials (audio/video clips, recorded stories), texts of different types, dictionaries, head set, media player/ recorder
objectives.assessment_criteria: Oral and written descriptions based on personal experience are produced logically

objectives.text: (b) Compose passages on specific contexts (structure: tenses –past progressive, present perfect, past perfect, present progressive, adjectives, adverbs, coordinators, prepositions, determiners, conjunctions)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Passages on specific contexts are composed well

objectives.text: (c) Present messages in formal discussions on various issues using correct grammar and vocabulary
objectives.assessment_criteria: Messages in formal discussions on various issues using correct grammar and vocabulary are presented rationally

sub_topics.title: Read texts for comprehension
competences: (a) Express the main ideas from a text
(b) Infer meanings of unfamiliar words and idiomatic expressions from a given text
(c) Relate the core messages from a text to real life experiences

objectives.text: (a) Express the main ideas from a text
objectives.resources: A variety of texts, selected poems, newspaper articles, journals, encyclopaedia, books
objectives.assessment_criteria: The main ideas of texts are expressed properly

objectives.text: (b) Infer meanings of unfamiliar words and idiomatic expressions from a given text
objectives.assessment_criteria: The meanings of unfamiliar words and idiomatic expressions from a given text are inferred accurately

objectives.text: (c) Relate the core messages from a text to real life experiences
objectives.assessment_criteria: The core messages from a text are related reasonably to real-life experiences

sub_topics.title: Comprehend oral messages with increasing difficulty
competences: (a) Synthesise ideas from a variety of oral sources
(b) Summarise information from a variety of oral sources
(c) Participate in contextualised oral conversations

objectives.text: (a) Synthesise ideas from a variety of oral sources
objectives.resources: Oral texts, audio and audio-visual materials (audio and video clips)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Ideas from a variety of oral sources are synthesised correctly

objectives.text: (b) Summarise information from a variety of oral sources
objectives.assessment_criteria: Information from a variety of oral sources is summarised clearly

objectives.text: (c) Participate in contextualised oral conversations
objectives.teaching_methods: Debate, Dialogue, Roleplay, Jigsaw, Round table circle, Pub quiz
objectives.assessment_criteria: Participations in contextualised oral conversations are done effectively

sub_topics.title: Respond appropriately in a variety of oral and written communication contexts
competences: (a) Express ideas and opinions in different group communicative settings (differing, counter-arguing, supporting ideas)
(b) Use appropriate non-verbal cues in group communication
(c) Use appropriate language to respond to messages in online group communicative contexts (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram)

objectives.text: (a) Express ideas and opinions in different group communicative settings (differing, counter-arguing, supporting ideas)
objectives.resources: Dictionaries, a variety of texts, audio and audiovisual materials
objectives.assessment_criteria: Opinions and facts in mass communication are expressed clearly

objectives.text: (b) Use appropriate non-verbal cues in group communication
objectives.assessment_criteria: Non-verbal cues in group communication are used appropriately

objectives.text: (c) Use appropriate language to respond to messages in online group communicative contexts (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram)
objectives.assessment_criteria: The appropriate language is used in online group communicative contexts

sub_topics.title: Use appropriate grammar and vocabulary for oral communication in a variety of contexts
competences: (a) Describe various locations (structure: prepositions, adjectives, adverbs)
(b) Express quality and quantity of objects and living organisms (structure: adjectives, quantifiers, adverbs)
(c) Negotiate prices using appropriate expressions (e.g., convincing a customer to buy a product, convincing a seller to lower the price) (Structure: May I…, I would like…, could you …, I offer you…)
(d) Request for services in different contexts
(e) Participate in various conversations in different contexts (e.g., discussions, dialogues) by initiating, intervening, changing a topic, turn-taking and closing

objectives.text: (a) Describe various locations (structure: prepositions, adjectives, adverbs)
objectives.resources: Recorded materials (audio/video clips, recorded stories), on various situations
objectives.assessment_criteria: Various locations are described well

objectives.text: (b) Express quality and quantity of objects and living organisms (structure: adjectives, quantifiers, adverbs)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Qualities and quantities of objects and living organisms are expressed correctly

objectives.text: (c) Negotiate prices using appropriate expressions (e.g., convincing a customer to buy a product, convincing a seller to lower the price) (Structure: May I…, I would like…, could you …, I offer you…)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Negotiations over the price using appropriate expressions are done

objectives.text: (d) Request for services in different contexts
objectives.assessment_criteria: Requests for services in different contexts are done correctly

objectives.text: (e) Participate in various conversations in different contexts (e.g., discussions, dialogues) by initiating, intervening, changing a topic, turn-taking and closing
objectives.teaching_methods: Discussion, Jigsaw, Dialogue, Interview, Talk show, Hot seat
objectives.assessment_criteria: Participations in various conversations in different contexts by initiating, intervening, changing a topic, turn-taking, closing are done

sub_topics.title: Create a variety of texts for different communicative purposes using the appropriate tone and register
competences: (a) Write claim and request letters in different contexts (e.g., learning facilities, sports gear, result report – Structure: I would like to bring your kind attention… I am writing to request…)
(b) Compose E-mails on various issues using appropriate language
(c) Create short stories on various topics (structure: once upon a time …, I wonder…, what if…, back in time…)

objectives.text: (a) Write claim and request letters in different contexts (e.g., learning facilities, sports gear, result report – Structure: I would like to bring your kind attention… I am writing to request…)
objectives.resources: Relevant texts, dictionaries, samples of claim and request letters
objectives.assessment_criteria: Claim and request letters in different contexts are written correctly

objectives.text: (b) Compose E-mails on various issues using appropriate language
objectives.assessment_criteria: Emails on various issues are composed using appropriate language

objectives.text: (c) Create short stories on various topics (structure: once upon a time …, I wonder…, what if…, back in time…)
objectives.teaching_methods: Demonstration, Story completion, Collaborative and independent practice
objectives.assessment_criteria: Short stories on various topics are created
